SectorRules.notes: Use reported period and peer percentile; deterioration trend matters.
Breach or thin buffer blocks positive state.
Use current regulatory thresholds; do not hard-code stale limits.
Prefer multi-period sustainable values over one-off earnings.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: P/B relative to sustainable ROE; normalized P/E; excess-return/residual-income reasoning
SectorRules.notes: Do not use low P/B alone as undervaluation.
Fast credit growth with worsening NPL/provisions is negative.
Dividend must be supported by capital and earnings.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: Do not default to EV/EBITDA or industrial FCFF
SectorRules.notes: Debt is operating raw material and regulatory capital dominates.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: installed capacity; COD; project stage; project life
SectorRules.notes: Separate construction-stage from operating assets.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: actual vs design generation; capacity factor; wet/dry season
SectorRules.notes: Normalize for hydrology and outages.
Generic tariff tables cannot substitute for project PPA.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: project cost and cost/MW; cost overrun
SectorRules.notes: Compare technology/site/stage before peer ranking.
Weak debt service can override apparent cheapness.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: O&M, outage, transmission and hydrology risk
SectorRules.notes: Use event/disclosure history, not only ratios.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: rights issues, promoter lock-in, repeated capital calls
SectorRules.notes: Adjust historical per-share metrics for corporate actions.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: finite-life DCF/FCFE; EV/EBITDA where operating; normalized earnings
SectorRules.notes: Avoid blind perpetual terminal value for finite concessions.
Assess trend and cyclicality.
ROIC should be considered against cost of capital.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: operating cash flow; free cash flow; owner earnings
SectorRules.notes: Estimate maintenance capex cautiously.
Stress-test cyclical earnings.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: revenue/EPS growth; capacity utilization; pricing power
SectorRules.notes: Growth that destroys ROIC is not automatically positive.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: DCF/FCFF or FCFE; EV/EBITDA; normalized P/E; FCF yield
SectorRules.notes: Triangulate at least two supported methods.
Flag growth unsupported by cash conversion.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: related parties, dilution, capex allocation, disclosures
SectorRules.notes: Governance flags can veto score.
Use NRB definitions and current period.
Regulatory breach blocks positive state.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: borrowings, savings/deposits, cost of funds, base rate
SectorRules.notes: Funding concentration and rate sensitivity matter.
Annualization and one-offs documented.
Rapid growth penalized when asset quality weakens.
Use current regulatory rules.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: P/B vs sustainable ROE; normalized P/E; excess-return logic
SectorRules.notes: Treat as financial institution, not industrial company.
Qualitative flags require provenance.
Use current NIA requirement.
Accounting transition can distort trend comparisons.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: premium growth, persistency when available, benefits/claims
SectorRules.notes: Growth without profitable economics is not enough.
Separate recurring yield from market gains.
Assess counterparty and retention.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: P/B vs sustainable ROE; normalized earnings/dividend; embedded-value only with valid inputs
SectorRules.notes: Do not fabricate embedded value.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: capital actions, related parties, disclosure quality
SectorRules.notes: Regulatory/enforcement flags matter.
Current regulatory requirement.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: loss/claims ratio; expense ratio; combined ratio where meaningful
SectorRules.notes: Definition must be consistent across peers.
Weak reserving can make earnings misleading.
Catastrophe exposure matters.
Do not mask underwriting weakness with market gains.

SectorRules.metric_or_rule: P/B vs sustainable ROE; normalized earnings/dividend
SectorRules.notes: Underwriting/reserve quality controls the multiple.
Scenario analysis preferred to naive trend extrapolation.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Good returns on equity with little or no debt are desirable.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Sector-adjust for financial firms where debt is operating input.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Owner earnings subtract required maintenance capital from accounting earnings plus noncash charges.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Maintenance capex is estimated and must show uncertainty.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Intrinsic value depends on expected future cash flows discounted appropriately.
Seek growth at a reasonable price rather than growth at any price.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: PEG is screening context, not intrinsic value.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Understand the business and inspect financial statements; growth must be financially supported.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Use primary filings for actual values.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Risk includes uncertainty and downside, not merely volatility.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Do not reduce risk to one beta/volatility number.

InvestorPrinciples.person_or_source: Howard Marks — The Calculus of Value
InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Relationship of price to value influences prospective return.
Selling is a separate, complex investment decision.
InvestorPrinciples.engine_translation: separate risk stop / thesis invalidation / valuation exit / trim

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Start with financial indicators and company growth.
Also examine NEPSE/sector indices, return history, sentiment and market cycles.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Cycle forecasts are not treated as facts.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Plan actions and exits in advance; correct rumor-based mistakes rather than letting losses escalate.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Engine thresholds remain explicit implementation choices.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Highlighted consistently good companies and dividends.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Too little evidence for a full personal methodology.

InvestorPrinciples.documented_principle: Documented material focuses on market structure, policy/cost and investor protection.
InvestorPrinciples.caveat: Do not invent a personal stock-selection formula.

FormulaRegistry.name: NPL_ratio
FormulaRegistry.interpretation: lower is better, subject to definitions

FormulaRegistry.name: Sustainable_EPS_growth
FormulaRegistry.interpretation: internal consistency between growth, return and payout

FormulaRegistry.name: Justified_PB
FormulaRegistry.input_requirements: sustainable ROE; stable g; cost of equity
FormulaRegistry.interpretation: fundamental P/B anchor when assumptions valid

FormulaRegistry.name: Owner_earnings
FormulaRegistry.input_requirements: audited cash flow; maintenance capex estimate

FormulaRegistry.name: Finite_life_DCF
FormulaRegistry.formula_or_method: sum(FCF_t/(1+k)^t) for remaining project life + explicitly justified residual only
FormulaRegistry.input_requirements: cash flows; remaining life; discount rate

FormulaRegistry.name: Combined_ratio
FormulaRegistry.interpretation: underwriting profitability; below 100% often indicates underwriting profit

FormulaRegistry.name: Margin_of_safety
FormulaRegistry.source_basis: NPSE engine implementation choice inspired by value discipline

FormulaRegistry.name: Data_confidence
FormulaRegistry.formula_or_method: weighted coverage of authority, freshness, agreement, history and critical fields

FormulaRegistry.name: Sector_percentile
FormulaRegistry.formula_or_method: empirical midrank percentile within comparable same-sector peers after clipping

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: show evidence-qualified candidates first; show no candidate if gates fail
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not fill Top 3 with daily gainers

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: show why, why now/wait, why wrong, entry range, invalidation and exit
show raw metrics, periods, sources, formula contributions and scenarios

ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not treat retrieval time as observation freshness

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: separate construction/operating, PPA, generation, debt and finite-life valuation
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not compare MW/cost without project context

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: use margins, ROIC, cash conversion, owner earnings/DCF
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not reward accounting EPS without cash support

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: use NRB asset-quality/capital/funding metrics and P/B/ROE logic
use solvency, liabilities/reserves, investment income and long-duration economics
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not apply non-life combined-ratio logic blindly

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: use underwriting, reserve, reinsurance and catastrophe metrics
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not let investment income hide underwriting weakness

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: attribute documented principles and label engine choices separately
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not claim case studies are objectively top investors

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: walk-forward only with contemporaneously available data and adjusted outcomes
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: no look-ahead or synthetic performance claims

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: retain market tracker as engineering/data diagnostic
ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not make it primary product

ImplementationMapping.required_behavior: prefer primary sources; store provenance, period, publication and retrieval timestamps

ImplementationMapping.do_not_do: do not bury scoring rules in React UI
